items.headline: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
items.excerpt: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

items.headline: Wiz’s CTO on PHP2Shell and the coming ‘vulnpocalypse’
items.excerpt: The PHP scare may have faded from your feed, but the cleanup is far from over. Last week, two critical bugs in the open source language behind roughly 70% of websites left organizations scrambling to fix their systems, with some taking sites offline until the vulnerabilities could be patched.

Last week, two critical bugs in the open source language behind roughly 70% of websites left organizations scrambling to fix their systems, with some taking sites offline until the vulnerabilities could be patched.

items.headline: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
items.excerpt: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.

items.headline: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
items.excerpt: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.

items.headline: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
items.excerpt: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.

items.headline: South Korea’s financial industry hit by fresh wave of cyberattacks
items.excerpt: South Korea’s financial institutions have been hit by another wave of cyberattacks, highlighting the growing risk of AI-driven hacking in Asia.

items.headline: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
items.excerpt: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

items.headline: 7 days until TechCrunch Founder Summit: Save up to $100 on your pass before doors open
items.excerpt: In just 7 days, TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston’s SoWa Power Station on November 4. Your chance to save up to $100 on tickets is running out, and the opportunity to learn and connect directly with experienced founders, investors, and startup leaders is almost here.

items.headline: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
items.excerpt: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.

items.headline: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
items.excerpt: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.

items.headline: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
items.excerpt: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say.

items.headline: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant
items.excerpt: The banking giant reminds customers that "you're responsible for activity" resulting from your AI agents' access.

items.headline: Who’s really in charge at Anthropic after the IPO?
items.excerpt: Here's a clear explanation of Anthropic's incredibly complex governance structure.

items.headline: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
items.excerpt: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

items.headline: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
items.excerpt: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

items.headline: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
items.excerpt: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

items.headline: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
items.excerpt: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

items.headline: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
items.excerpt: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

items.headline: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
items.excerpt: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.
